instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

atoms.a:
Someone told you that they had sore muscles after a long workout.

What could you say?

Just last week, someone told you that you shouldn’t eat dessert before a main meal. Now, you see them eating dessert before their meal.

What could you say?

Your teacher tells you that your class will be receiving a new classmate. Some people are gossiping and saying that the new kid looks mean.

What could you say?

b.sound: Don’t judge a book by its cover.
A picture is worth a thousand words.

atoms.a:
Your sibling says they always do their chores and keep their room clean. Yet, they barely do.

What could you say?

Your friend started learning skateboarding. They tell you that they want to try out one of the hardest skateboard parks at the weekend.

What could you say?

b.sound: Learn to walk before you run.
Not all that glitters is gold.
